name: questionnaire
title: Questionnaire
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova questionnaire, fixed: the field's selection colours are its own (::selection), not its descendants' too, a rule every element of the page tried on every restyle; choices are light rows, not a stack of form fields: no border (but a keyboard focus's ring) and a grey row when checked; invalid, the choices and the Other field stay grey and the error is a line of an icon and red words under them; a choice's number key leads it in a hairline square and shows the choice, filled when checked, in place of the radio or checkbox; the Other field among the choices (QuestionnaireInput in QuestionnaireChoices) is one of their rows, not a form field, its placeholder in grey ("Something else…"), led by the key after the choices', which types in it, and grey like a checked choice once it has words. A single choice chosen (a click, its number key) goes on to the next question, not on the last nor by the arrow keys (advance); a field-only question, come to, is typed in; QuestionnaireNavigation is Previous, Skip, Next and Submit, each where it applies, and with onDecline a quiet Decline (QuestionnaireDecline, labels.decline) on every question, the way out of the whole questionnaire; QuestionnaireActions is a row, a Decline at its start; one question shows no progress. Its spacing on the 4px module (docs/grid.md).
